code:
Notepad compile: 'textAccepted
	editor ifNotNil: [ text := editor text ].
	file ifNotNil: [ self save ] ifNil: [ self saveAs ]' classified: 'views'.
Notepad compile: 'saveAs
	"Ask for a destination file, then save there. Does nothing when
	the dialog is cancelled."
	| chosen |
	chosen := self requestSaveFileReference.
	chosen ifNil: [ ^ nil ].
	^ self saveTo: chosen' classified: 'saving'.
Notepad compile: 'requestSaveFileReference
	^ UIManager default
		chooseForSaveFileReference: ''Save Notepad as...''
		extensions: #( ''txt'' )
		path: FileLocator documents' classified: 'saving'.
Notepad compile: 'labelString
	^ ''Notepad'', (file ifNotNil: [ '' - '', file basename ] ifNil: [ '''' ])' classified: 'views'.
Notepad compile: 'updateTitle
	window ifNotNil: [ window setLabel: self labelString ]' classified: 'views'.
Notepad compile: 'saveTo: aFileReference
	aFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :stream | stream nextPutAll: text ].
	file := aFileReference.
	self updateTitle.
	^ aFileReference' classified: 'saving'.
Notepad compile: 'openView
	"Open a wrapped Rubric editor on the text. Ctrl+S (accept) saves:
	to the set file, or via a save-as dialog when none is set."
	| morph |
	morph := RubScrolledTextMorph new.
	morph beWrapped.
	morph setText: text.
	editor := morph.
	morph textArea announcer
		when: RubTextAccepted
		send: #textAccepted
		to: self.
	window := SystemWindow new.
	window setLabel: self labelString.
	window addMorph: morph frame: (0 @ 0 corner: 1 @ 1).
	window extent: 500 @ 400.
	window openInWorld.
	window position: 60 @ 60.
	^ window' classified: 'views'.
